ice_bolt: Available at Level 1, providing baseline damage synergy scaling for advanced Cold Spells.
frozen_armor: Essential early 1-point defensive skill with long duration; freezes melee attackers.
frost_nova: Excellent instant AoE crowd control skill, ideal for self-defense when surrounded.
ice_blast: High single-target burst; completely freezes regular monsters in place.
shiver_armor: Grants higher defense than Frozen Armor; slows attacking enemies even on missed hits.
glacial_spike: Top-tier right-click single/small AoE instant freeze skill for Blizzard builds.
blizzard: S-tier league starter & magic find skill; prime choice for Ancient Tunnels, Mephisto, and Pindleskin.
chilling_armor: The signature armor skill triggered when struck while wearing the Fortitude runeword.
frozen_orb: Fully operational with only base points and Ice Bolt maxed; prime flexible clearing tool for dual-element Sorcs.
cold_mastery: In D2R Sunder charm eras, pairs with Cold Rupture to shred broken resistances, ensuring top-tier clearing.
charged_bolt: Fires multiple bolts that hit large bosses simultaneously at point-blank range; great early boss killer.
static_field: Legendary boss killer! Cuts boss health by percentage down to 50% in Hell difficulty.
telekinesis: Core synergy passive for Energy Shield: reduces mana consumed per damage absorbed.
nova: Received Static Field synergy in Patch 2.4; self-wield Infinity Nova is a pinnacle farming Meta.
lightning: Primary piercing burst skill for Lightning Sorcs; devastating corridor clearing with 117 FCR.
chain_lightning: Supreme wide-area clearing skill; auto-targets and arcs between dispersed monster packs.
teleport: The most iconic mobility skill in Diablo II; crosses walls, repositions mercs, and rushes maps.
thunder_storm: Passive automated lightning strikes; handy for cleanup and PvP harassment.
energy_shield: Key survival skill for ES Sorcs; maxing Telekinesis makes Sorceresses with meager life tanky as steel.
lightning_mastery: The source of exponential lightning damage spikes; every skill level yields massive DPS leaps.
fire_bolt: Level 1 starter spell; delivers solid synergy bonuses to Fire Ball and Meteor.
warmth: Essential 1-point wonder for virtually all spellcasters; dramatically eases mana regeneration.
inferno: Channeled straight-line flame jet; handy in narrow corridors during early leveling.
blaze: Gained massive run speed bonus in Patch 2.4; legendary kite-and-burn strategy against early bosses like Duriel.
fire_ball: Heart and soul of the Fire Sorc; blazing fast cast frame, satisfying projectile, and huge burst.
fire_wall: Nightmare for static bosses; requires minimal skill point investment for absurd sheet damage.
enchant: Core of the Enchantress build; prime attack rating & fire buff for bows, Zealots, summoners, and alts.
meteor: Pinnacle single-hit fire burst; devastates non-fire-immune targets when combined with Fire Ball spam.
hydra: Patch 2.4 removed the summoning cooldown! Summon multiple heads to scout corners and melt foes safely.
fire_mastery: Top passive skill providing game-changing damage multiplication for Fire Ball, Meteor, and Hydra.
sacrifice: Core synergy skill for Zeal; adds +12% damage to Zeal per invested point.
smite: The ultimate Uber Tristram boss slayer! Never misses and seamlessly applies CB, Open Wounds, and Life Tap.
holy_bolt: Damages demons since Patch 2.4! Features 100% pierce, shredding packs alongside Fist of the Heavens.
zeal: Primary physical combat skill for Zealots; achieves the blistering 4-frame attack cap with Fanaticism.
charge: Rapid traversal across maps, closing gaps on archers, and devastating rush attacks in PvP.
vengeance: Primary skill for the Avenger; delivers tri-elemental damage that trivializes all immune monsters.
blessed_hammer: The legendary Hammerdin staple; magic damage bypasses nearly all Hell resistances to farm anything.
conversion: Clever crowd control technique; converted foes draw monster aggro away from the Paladin.
holy_shield: Paladin survival cornerstone! Reaches the 75% max block cap with minimal dexterity investment.
fist_of_the_heavens: Ascended to God-tier in Patch 2.4! King of Chaos Sanctuary, raining holy bolts to melt demons and undead.
might: Signature aura of Act 2 Offensive mercenaries; accessible constant physical damage aura.
holy_fire: Normal difficulty leveling deity! Stacks up to Level 44 with Dual Dragon + Hand of Justice to walk-kill Hell.
thorns: Reflects flat physical damage since Patch 2.4; excels against fast-attacking monster swarms.
blessed_aim: Passively increases Blessed Hammer damage by 14% per point; mandatory max synergy for Hammerdins.
holy_freeze: Native aura on Doom runeword and Act 2 Defensive mercs; delivers premier crowd control and chill.
holy_shock: Core of the Dual Dream Paladin! Dual Dream helm + shield stack to Level 30 Holy Shock for massive melee hit damage.
sanctuary: Native aura on Lawbringer and Azurewrath; bypasses physical resistances of ghosts and undead monsters.
fanaticism: Flagship aura of Faith and Beast! Break maximum attack speed frames for melee combat and Bowazons.
concentration: Native aura on Pride runeword; the only aura that boosts magical Blessed Hammer damage (at 50% efficiency)!
conviction: Soul aura of the Infinity runeword! The foundational pillar for breaking enemy elemental immunities.
prayer: Synergizes with Cleansing and Meditation to form a triple-aura passive health regeneration chain.
resist_fire: Passively increases maximum fire resistance; top skill against Diablo's red lightning firestorm.
defiance: Native aura on the Exile runeword; the bedrock for pushing Paladin defense over 20,000.
cleansing: Core aura on Cure helm runeword (Patch 2.6); rapidly removes curses and poisons upon application.
vigor: Native movement speed aura on Harmony bow; essential sprint toggle for towns and map traversing.
meditation: Core aura of the Insight runeword; infinite mana fountain for spellcasters throughout the game.
redemption: Native aura on the Phoenix shield; instantly consumes nearby corpses to refill both life and mana spheres.
salvation: Life-saving team aura to counter Uber Mephisto's Level 20 Conviction aura in Tristram.
jab: Early leveling skill for spear and javazons; triggers Crushing Blow with rapid three-strike bursts.
power_strike: Early synergy skill for Lightning Fury and Charged Strike.
poison_javelin: Terrific early leveling tool to kite swarms; leaves lethal toxic clouds monsters walk through.
impale: Heavy boss armor-rending attack for Spearazons; severely cripples enemy movement and defense.
lightning_bolt: Excellent backup projectile to convert physical damage to lightning when facing ghosts and stone skins.
charged_strike: The single highest boss-melting burst skill in D2R! Huge bosses absorb all released bolts instantly.
plague_javelin: Core skill for Poison Javas; Patch 2.4 shortened cooldown and poison duration to double burst DPS.
fend: Patch 2.4 fixed the dodge-lock bug; premier melee multi-target sweep for spear-wielding Amazons.
lightning_strike: Infinite chain-bounce skill; conserves javelin durability compared to throwing when packs are dispersed.
lightning_fury: Diablo II's eternal god of mass clearing! Cows pack slaughterer; paired with Titan's and pierce to vaporize screens.
inner_sight: Early defense shredder and scout skill; also the signature ability of Act 1 Rogue mercenaries.
critical_strike: Physical burst cornerstone for Bowazons and Spearazons; checks independently alongside Deadly Strike.
dodge: Melee dodge defense; Patch 2.4 decoupled it from attack animation locks for dramatically safer combat.
slow_missiles: God-tier anti-projectile barrier against Burning Souls, Gloams, Sirens, and archer swarms.
avoid: Passive survival technique against ranged arrows and magical projectile attacks.
penetrate: Core attack rating passive ensuring arrows and javelins consistently hit high-defense Hell monsters.
dopplezon: Potent tactical decoy; reveals dark corners and diverts lethal Fanaticism lightning packs.
evade: Passive defense while sprinting and repositioning; prevents getting sniped while rounding corners.
valkyrie: One of the beefiest solo summons in Diablo II! Summons equipped with high-tier rare gear that tank Hell Baal.
pierce: Core multiplier for Bowazons and Javazons! Combines with Razortail for 100% pierce on Lightning Fury.
magic_arrow: Infinite ammo backup when quivers run dry; converts physical damage to overcome Physical Immunes.
fire_arrow: Early leveling fire skill; provides synergy scaling for late-game Immolation Arrow.
cold_arrow: Core synergy skill for Freezing Arrow, adding +12% cold damage per invested point.
multiple_shot: Flagship screen-wide clearing skill for physical Bowazons (Windforce / Faith); fires beyond visible screen.
exploding_arrow: Heart of the Demon Machine Bowazon; extreme fire rate with 100% piercing chain explosions.
ice_arrow: Single-target hard freeze skill; shines when locking down dangerous Frenzied Champion packs.
guided_arrow: PVP and single-target boss sniper skill; automatically locks onto targets with 100% chance to hit.
strafe: Patch 2.4 removed the damage penalty and added synergies! Fires machine-gun volleys to proc CB, Decrepify, and leech.
immolation_arrow: Patch 2.4 significantly reduced casting delay; the premier burst attack for fire bow builds.
freezing_arrow: Apex crowd control bow skill! Rains freezing blooms across packs that lock down entire rooms.
raise_skeleton: Core bedrock of Summoners; high levels combined with Skeleton Mastery tank any Hell boss.
skeleton_mastery: Mandatory passive for Summon Necromancers; provides massive leaps in skeleton HP and attack damage.
clay_golem: The supreme boss-slowing tank! Clay Golem slow stacks with Decrepify to reduce Baal to slow motion.
golem_mastery: Essential passive that ensures high-value Iron Golems survive without untimely despawns.
raise_skeletal_mage: Buffed significantly in Patch 2.4; cold mages shatter corpses while poison mages stop monster health regeneration.
bloodgolem: Patch 2.4 removed the health penalty that drained Necromancer HP when the golem took damage.
irongolem: Premier Summoner meta: summon an Iron Golem from an Insight runeword for permanent Meditation aura on the go!
summon_resist: Critical survival passive that protects skeleton armies from Diablo's firestorm and Baal's cold waves.
firegolem: High aggro taunt golem that detonates in a fierce blaze of fire upon defeat.
revive: The ultimate anti-boss summon! Revives Urdar heavy bludgeoners with innate Crushing Blow to topple Uber bosses in seconds.
teeth: Level 1 ranged starter spell; provides dependable synergy scaling for Bone Spear and Bone Spirit.
bone_armor: Absorption scales purely from Bone Wall and Prison synergies; vital shield against archers and physical assassins.
poison_dagger: Provides a crucial damage synergy to Poison Nova; a must-max for dedicated venom builds.
corpse_explosion: Diablo II's most iconic S-tier clearing skill! Once the first monster falls, chain explosions clear the entire room.
bone_wall: Tactical barrier that herds monsters into corridors while feeding synergies into Bone Armor and Bone Spear.
poison_explosion: Adds +10% poison damage synergy per point to Poison Nova.
bone_spear: Primary missile skill for Bone Necros; pierces in a laser line through dense subterranean dungeons.
bone_prison: Locks down bosses like Diablo inside a bone ring where they cannot reach melee range.
poison_nova: Signature skill for the Poisonmancer! Pairs with Death's Web and Lower Resist to melt Hell Cows in 2 seconds.
bone_spirit: Highest single-target magic missile for Bone Necros; automatically homes in on bosses and PvP duelists.
amplify_damage: God-tier curse that breaks Physical Immunity and doubles Corpse Explosion clearing speed.
dim_vision: The ultimate neutralizer for dangerous ranged foes like Burning Souls, Gloams, archers, and Sirens.
weaken: Decrepify prerequisite; early minor curse to keep frail mercenaries from getting squashed.
iron_maiden: Classic Normal difficulty strategy paired with Clay Golem: bosses kill themselves on reflected damage.
terror: Life-saving crowd dispersal when trapped in corners; also serves as a path prerequisite for Decrepify.
confuse: Forces monster swarms to turn on each other; cast into dense cow clusters to watch them brawl.
life_tap: Essential lifeline for Smiter Paladins fighting Uber Tristram bosses; every hit instantly restores full HP.
attract: Cannot be overwritten by other curses; perfect lure to cluster packs and create meat shields.
decrepify: The most strategically versatile curse in Diablo II! Cast via The Reaper's Toll to break physical immunities and cripple bosses.
lower_resist: Essential resistance shredder for Poisonmancers; beloved team curse for Sorcs, Javazons, and Trapsins.
bash: Level 1 starter melee strike; provides early synergy damage to Frenzy and Concentrate.
leap: Early obstacle jumper; high levels emit an expansive shockwave that knocks back and stuns screens of monsters.
stun: Reliable single-target lockdown against enraged Champions and elite packs.
leap_attack: Patch 2.4 revamped leap velocity and landing fluidity, adding massive AoE damage for backline diving.
concentrate: Uninterruptible melee attack for dueling heavy hitters; guarantees strikes land without interruption.
frenzy: Flagship skill for dual-wielding Barbarians; stacks movement speed beyond Teleport and shreds with Crushing Blow.
whirlwind: Iconic signature Barbarian skill! Dual Grief Whirlwind is the peak of physical clearing and Travincal gold finding.
berserk: Doom for physical immune monsters! The premier attack for Pit Zerkers to one-shot Level 85 unique monsters.
blade_mastery: Mandatory passive for mainstream Grief sword setups (Phase Blade / Colossus Blade).
axe_mastery: Core weapon passive for Berserker Axe Grief or Beast configurations.
mace_mastery: Essential mastery for leveling with the Immortal King set or heavy Thunder Mauls.
pole_arm_mastery: Damage foundation for polearm-wielding builds and heavy two-handed polearms.
throwing_mastery: Ascended in Patch 2.4! Grants critical hits the ability to replenish quantity, liberating Throw Barbs from repairing.
increased_stamina: Prerequisite for Increased Speed; guarantees endless sprint stamina.
iron_skin: Passively elevates Barbarian defense past 10,000 without toggling active skills.
increased_speed: Core of the Barbarian's innate swiftness, providing effortless traversal across Travincal and dungeons.
natural_resistance: The most generous resistance passive in D2R! Just 1 point plus +skills grants over +50% All Resistances.
howl: Signature tool for Pit Zerkers: send all minion swarms fleeing in terror to isolate the elite champion.
find_potion: Feeds core synergy chance to Find Item; Patch 2.4 adds +1% horking chance per invested point.
taunt: Pulls ranged archers, Shaman summoners, and fleeing monsters straight into melee reach.
shout: One of the three core warcries; massively bolsters party defense against melee attacks.
find_item: Diablo II's exclusive wealth multiplier! Hork Travincal council corpses a second time for High Runes (Ber / Jah).
battle_cry: Terrific defense shredder when attack rating is low; reduces enemy armor to paper with one shout.
battle_orders: The undisputed SSS-tier team buff in Diablo II! The foundational reason why Call to Arms (CTA) is universal.
grim_ward: Substantially enhanced in Patch 2.4; acts like an active damage amplification totem against swarms.
battle_command: The opening shout of every battle ritual! Grants +1 to All Skills to maximize subsequent BO and defense buffs.
war_cry: Primary damage and infinite stun spell for Singer Barbarians; locks monsters in place with high FCR.
firestorm: Level 1 fire starter skill; also the spell triggered automatically by the Hellfire Torch.
molten_boulder: Delivers dual physical and fire damage; rolls through narrow corridors pushing and clearing mobs.
arctic_blast: Patch 2.4 fixed the damage bug and expanded range; useful early crowd control for Wind Druids.
eruption: Leveling juggernaut from Levels 1-30! Multiple fissures erupt under large bosses to melt HP bars instantly.
cyclone_armor: Crucial survival barrier for Wind Druids! Absorbs thousands of points of elemental fire, cold, and lightning damage.
twister: Core stunning projectile for Wind Druids, feeding massive damage synergies into Tornado.
volcano: Strongest single-target boss demolisher for Fire Druids; combines physical boulder strikes with volcanic magma.
tornado: The heart and soul of the Wind Druid! Pure physical damage ignores elemental immunities to sweep through Hell.
armageddon: Patch 2.4 removed prerequisites and allows casting while shapeshifted in Werewolf/Werebear form!
hurricane: Active aura of Wind Druids; continuously chills and damages every foe entering melee vicinity.
wearwolf: Base form for Fury Werewolves; Patch 2.4 loosened weapon IAS mechanics to accommodate diverse high-damage armaments.
shape_shifting: Mandatory passive for shapeshifters, granting Werewolves and Werebears massive multi-thousand HP pools.
wearbear: Core tank form; grants fortress-like defense bonuses and colossal raw melee attack scaling.
feral_rage: Core sustainability skill for Werewolves; build red orb charges to leech entire health globes per hit.
maul: Primary charge-up skill for Werebears; stacking green charges multiplies base damage output significantly.
rabies: Venomous bite skill; infects one foe and spreads like dominoes across entire packs until all collapse.
fire_claws: Blistering fast elemental claw strike for Bear/Wolf builds, designed to shred stone skin Physical Immunes.
hunger: Emergency life and mana siphon; one quick bite instantly replenishes both spheres from near death.
shock_wave: The single strongest non-stop crowd control stun in Diablo II! Stuns Gloams and Flayers helplessly indefinitely.
fury: Pinnacle finisher for physical Werewolves! Paired with Tomb Reaver or Death for blistering 5-hit boss shredding.
raven: Mythic rework in Patch 2.4! Ravens deal high sustained damage without attack count limits, anchoring Summoner leveling.
plague_poppy: Early poison creeper; also serves as the core synergy damage booster for Rabies Werewolves.
oak_sage: Party favorite health totem! Stacks with Barbarian BO to push party HP effortlessly past 5,000.
summon_spirit_wolf: Patch 2.4 allows summoning wolves and bears simultaneously, commanding a massive animal army.
cycle_of_life: Corpse eater that prevents Fallen Shamans from reviving minions while feeding continuous health back to the Druid.
heart_of_wolverine: Premier physical damage and attack rating aura spirit for Fury Wolves and Summon Druids.
summon_fenris: Agile attack wolves of the zoo; deals ferocious tearing bites with remarkable movement speed.
vines: Natural mana-restoring vine that completely resolves mana sustain for Shapeshift and Wind builds.
spirit_of_barbs: Patch 2.4 overhauled reflection scaling; monsters striking the Druid pack take severe recoil damage.
summon_grizzly: The undisputed alpha summon of the Druid pack! Heavy paw strikes stun elites while tanking Baal with ease.
tiger_strike: The most colossal single-hit physical charge-up skill for martial and kick assassins.
dragon_talon: The soul finisher of Mosaic Assassins and kick boss-slayers! Triggers dozens of spell procs per second.
fists_of_fire: Fire martial charge-up; fuels the roaring fireballs and flaming terrain of Mosaic finishers.
dragon_claw: Primary dual-claw melee finishing move for claw-wielding Assassins.
cobra_strike: The perpetual engine of Mosaic Assassins! 2-3 charges keep life and mana spheres perpetually at 100%.
claws_of_thunder: Core DPS charge-up for Mosaic Assassins! Rains Charged Bolts and Novas to disintegrate Players 8 Hell.
dragon_tail: Pairs Tiger Strike with Dragon Tail to release explosive fire AoE kicks dealing hundreds of thousands of damage.
blades_of_ice: Supreme crowd control charge-up for Mosaic builds; freezes screens of monsters into solid ice sculptures.
dragon_flight: Innate teleport kick! Teleports directly onto elite commanders across cliffs and terrain without Enigma.
royal_strike: The zenith of Martial Arts! Under dual Mosaic runewords, rains Meteors, Chain Lightnings, and Chaos orbs constantly.
claw_mastery: Foundational physical mastery for martial and Blade Fury claw assassins.
psychic_hammer: Early ranged knockback and spellcaster interruption tool.
quickness: Burst of Speed: grants blinding run/walk and attack frames; mutually exclusive with Fade for speed-farming.
weapon_block: The ONLY passive in Diablo II capable of blocking magical spells (Meteor, Bone Spirit, Lightning) with dual claws!
cloak_of_shadows: Ultimate counter against Gloams, Souls, and Sirens; blinds the entire room and cuts enemy defense in half.
fade: The pinnacle defensive aura (also found on Treachery); maxes all resistances and grants hidden physical damage reduction.
shadow_warrior: Tactical clone that mimics your currently selected left and right skills (such as placing specific traps).
mind_blast: Diablo II's most oppressive crowd control spell! Stuns entire screens and converts enemies to fight for you.
venom: Best friend of fast-hitting kicks and blades; 0.4s duration reapplies high flat poison damage on every hit.
shadow_master: Autonomous master shadow that summons traps, casts Mind Blast, and tanks damage with enormous HP.
fire_trauma: Premier early fire trap for Lightning Trapsins when confronting lightning immune monsters; rapid throw rate.
shock_field: Key synergy skill for Lightning Sentry; packs formidable stationary choke-point damage.
blade_sentinel: Patch 2.4 boosted weapon damage scaling and eliminated casting cooldowns for physical blade builds.
charged_bolt_sentry: Prerequisite and core synergy skill for Lightning Sentry.
wake_of_fire_sentry: Normal and Nightmare leveling deity! 5 fire traps emit overlapping flame waves that incinerate rooms.
blade_fury: Machine-gun blade turret skill! Snipes bosses from off-screen at up to 6 blades per second to apply Crushing Blow.
lightning_sentry: The beating heart of the Trapsin! Deploy up to 5 automated turrets that snipe enemies safely and comfortably.
inferno_sentry: Patch 2.4 expanded range and damage; excels against stationary single-target bosses.
death_sentry: Automated Corpse Explosion trap! Once the first monster falls to Lightning Sentry, Death Sentry detonates the room.
blade_shield: Patch 2.4 expanded duration and reduced durability drain; orbiting defensive buzzsaw for melee assassins.
